name: Hosta 'Blue Mouse Ears'
description: Compact hosta with thick, cupped blue-green leaves. Excellent for shady borders and containers. Deer-resistant once established.
careNotes: Prefers moist, well-drained soil. Slug bait recommended in wet climates.

name: Astilbe 'Fanal'
description: Feathery dark-red plumes over bronze-green foliage. Reliable bloomer for shady, moist beds. Attracts pollinators.
careNotes: Keep soil consistently moist; mulch to retain moisture in summer.

name: Japanese Painted Fern
description: Silvery-blue and burgundy fronds add color to dark corners without a single flower. Slow-spreading and low-maintenance.
careNotes: Currently out of stock; next batch expected in propagation in ~10 days.

name: Coneflower 'Magnus'
description: Classic purple coneflower, drought-tolerant once established. Long summer bloom, popular with pollinators and finches.
careNotes: Needs 6+ hours direct sun. Deadhead to extend bloom.

name: Lavender 'Munstead'
description: Compact, cold-hardy lavender with classic fragrance. Great for borders, containers, and pollinator gardens.
careNotes: Needs sharp drainage — amend heavy clay soil with grit before planting.

name: Boston Fern (indoor/patio)
description: Classic hanging fern for shaded porches and indoor spaces. Lush, arching fronds; humidity-loving.
careNotes: Mist regularly or place on a pebble tray; keep soil evenly moist.

name: Carbon-Steel Hand Trowel
description: Forged carbon-steel blade with an ergonomic beech handle. Rust-resistant coating, lifetime-sharpened edge.
careNotes: Wipe dry after use; oil the blade seasonally.

name: Bypass Pruning Shears
description: Precision bypass blades for clean cuts on live stems up to 3/4 inch. Non-slip grip, replaceable spring.
careNotes: Not designed for dead or woody branches over 2cm — use loppers instead.

name: Stainless Garden Fork
description: Four-tine stainless fork for aerating beds and turning compost. Won't rust or stain in wet soil.
careNotes: Dishwasher-safe head; wooden handle should stay dry.

name: Acacia Wood Bistro Set
description: Two chairs and a round table in oiled acacia wood. Foldable for storage, rated for year-round outdoor use.
careNotes: Re-oil annually to maintain water resistance.

name: Cantilever Patio Umbrella (10ft)
description: Offset cantilever umbrella with 360° rotation and crank lift. Water-resistant polyester canopy, UPF 50+.
careNotes: Close in high winds above 25 mph; base sold separately.

name: Drip Irrigation Starter Kit (25 plants)
description: 1/4-inch drip line, emitters, and connectors for up to 25 plants. Connects to any standard hose spigot.
careNotes: Flush lines monthly to prevent emitter clogging from mineral buildup.

name: Mechanical Hose Timer
description: No-battery mechanical dial timer, waters for up to 2 hours before auto shut-off. Simple twist-to-set operation.
careNotes: Drain and store indoors before the first frost.

name: Organic Raised-Bed Soil Mix (1.5 cu ft)
description: OMRI-listed blend of compost, coco coir, and aged bark for raised beds and containers. pH balanced 6.2–6.8.
careNotes: Top-dress with compost each season rather than fully replacing.
